dct_title_s: Geographia vetus ex antiquis, et melioris notae scriptoribus nuper collecta
dct_description_sm: per clarissimum virum P. Bertium Regis Galliarum Christianissimi geographum, nunc produit, & prostat.
4th recorded complete copy of the 1st edition.
Includes 2 of the earliest world maps showing California as an island.
